_comment: Template only -- copy to C:\ProgramData\SortViewCollector\config\collector_config.json and fill in real values. Never commit a filled-in copy anywhere (Git, a support ticket, a screenshot) alongside a real API token -- the token itself never belongs in this file at all, see _comment_token below.
_comment_batching: Optional, shown here at their defaults -- omit entirely to use the same values. max_records_per_batch matches the value already proven in months of live production use.
_comment_token: SORTVIEW_API_TOKEN is READ FROM THE ENVIRONMENT ONLY -- it must never appear in this file. Set it as a Machine-scope environment variable via collector/deploy/install-collector.ps1's token step (or set-sortview-api-token.ps1, reused from the continuous-agent deployment tooling) before running the collector or its preflight check.
_comment_parser: The production parser is NOT wired in yet in this phase (Phase 4c) -- the collector fails closed (exit code 2) and refuses to upload unparsed data until a later, separate parser-parity phase completes. Registering the Scheduled Task now is safe and structurally correct, but do not expect real data uploads until that phase is done -- see docs/collector-v1-admin-guide.md.
